products.notes: Official manual (Garmin CDN). 8 differential-balanced RCA in, full-scale sensitivity selectable 250 mV ... 7.1 V RMS (11 steps, default 1.0 V); optical + coax S/PDIF in (44.1-96k). 8 RCA out, 4 V RMS max, 450 ohm. 80 EQ bands total: 8 assignable 10-band EQs (graphic octave or parametric) - effectively 10 per output if one EQ per output. Delay per output (range not stated in manual). SNR 98 dB A-wtd re 4 V; THD+N 0.02%. D2Audio DAE-6, 24/48. Fuse 1 A. Includes DRC-200.
Same manual as TwK-88. Digital-only version: sole input is optical (Toslink) S/PDIF (e.g. from FiX 82). 8 RCA out 4 V RMS; 8 assignable 10-band EQs. 24/48 processing.

OEM integration processor (automatic setup with test signal, auto input level, auto delay/EQ correction). 8 differential-balanced inputs, range 250 mV - 30 V RMS (accepts speaker level). 6 RCA out (front/rear/sub pairs), 4 V RMS, 450 ohm. EQ: 30 bands x 2 channels at 1/3 octave (automatic correction, not user PEQ). SNR 96 dB re 4 V. D2Audio DAE-6 24/48. Fuse 1 A.
